description: Look up a domain's DNS records: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA and CAA. A record type the resolver could not answer is listed under unavailable.
name: dns_lookup

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

non_public_addresses.description: The A and AAAA addresses that are not globally reachable.

records.description: It holds one member for each record type. [] means the domain has no record of that type. null means the question failed, and unavailable says why. soa is also null when the domain has no SOA record. Then unavailable has no soa member.

rname.description: It is the mailbox of the zone's administrator, written as a DNS name.

services.description: The services a TXT record names. evidence is the word the service asks its customers to publish. A listed service is not proof that the domain uses it.

unavailable.description: It names each record type whose question failed, with its reason code. It is {} when every question was answered. The code says why the DNS question failed. It is nxdomain, server_error, truncated, malformed_answer, timeout or not_public_name.

title: DNS Lookup
